newsitem.title: USA: Bay State Gas to buy Savage-Alert for stock.
newsitem.headline: Bay State Gas to buy Savage-Alert for stock.

text.p: Bay State Gas Co said Wednesday it agreed to acquire closely-held Savage-Alert Inc for about 150,000 newly issued common shares representing a market value of approximately $4.25 million.
The company said the acquisition would result in a 1.1 percent increase in its outstanding shares.
Spokeswoman Carol Churchill said the utility is "not expecting any dilution in earnings" from the acquisiton.
Bay State said it plans to merge Savage-Alert with the company's affiliate, EnergyUSA, a nonregulated energy products and services retailer.
Savage-Alert is an energy design, engineering, and mechanical contracting firm, with annual revenues of about $13 million, serving customers coast to coast.

Under the terms of the letter of intent, Bay State said, the two entities will operate under a joint venture agreement until final regulatory approvals are received, which are anticipated within the next several months.

Bay State president Joel L. Singer said, "This acquisition effectively doubles the size of EnergyUSA, and more importantly, it brings significant technical skills and established distribution channels."
